text:
sam: Tiny PSA 4e2 big double good news: lina got promoted to Staff PM AND alex proposed last night!! :tada: :ring:
lina: oh my gosh thatsuch a toast moment omg 60d still processing. thanks everyone!!
jo: WHAT!! congrats lia!!! (and alex!!) we absolutely need a celebration.
marta: double celebration poll: :cupcake: lunchtime sweets or :sparkles: after-work drinks? react to vote.
dev: cupcakes please, desk-friendly is easiest. remote folks can send vids.
people-ops-bot: Promo logged for Lina (Staff PM). Swag tier unlocked. $175 celebratory budget authorized. If organizers prefer donation, reply with details.
lina: tiny note 9373fb not into big parties, would love a small midday cheer + card. also alex says hi and thanks yall.
sam: noted! small + sweet it is. can folks bring things that are easy to pack for a post-lunch stroll (well do a quick rooftop photo).
jo: I can bring dairy-free cupcakes and a little sparkling juice for non-drinkers.
marta: i'll bring a small bouquet (no lilies) and the card. @people-ops-bot please send a physical card.
people-ops-bot: Physical card request submitted. Link to sign: https://redwood.in/sigs/lina (link)
dev: remote peeps can drop short 15s vids in the thread and I'll stitch them into a single clip.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Lina double-win mini-cheer" Wed 12:30-12:45 Kitchen Island + Rooftop quick photo. Zoom attached for remote.
sam: also thinking tiny keepsakes? keychain or houseplant? Lina, preference?
lina: plant > anything that needs batteries lol. tiny succulent would be sweet.
jo: Succulents it is. who wants to pick up? I can swing by the market at 11:20.
marta: i'll bring a simple playlist 3b6 and a camera. quick, comfy, low-key is perfect.
people-ops-bot: Swag credit can be reallocated to keepsakes. Organizer, please confirm via DM to finalize spend.
dev: added a tiny confetti popper per consent (office-safe). promise it's tame.
lina: youre all too kind. extra tears rn. see you Wed and thanks for being the best team.
marta (reaction): :tada: (added by marta)
jo (reaction): :heart: (added by jo)
